verdict.rationale: MailerSend is an API-first service: email can be sent through its Email API or SMTP relay, and it ships official language libraries. That makes non-interactive, scripted use from automation possible, but nothing in the evidence documents a CLI, CI guidance, or a CI integration. missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/CD usage (e.g. a GitHub Action or pipeline examples), a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
